1.DESCRIPTION: A ride-sharing app where customers create ride requests and receive ride offers from drivers. The app handles route planning and provides a map-based visualization for setting up rides, displaying the planned route, and tracking the ride as it moves from the starting point to the destination.

TASKS.1: Implementation of authentication and authorization using JWT tokens with additional security measures
TASKS.2: Backend development with Spring Boot and REST APIs for ride requests and offers, including Bean Validation
TASKS.3: Real-time communication and live updates between customers and drivers using WebSockets (STOMP)
TASKS.4: Calculation and display of driver statistics (daily and monthly) for performance analysis using SQL queries

2.DESCRIPTION: An intelligent, video-based system for analyzing and monitoring road traffic, detecting congestion, and accurately identifying lanes and lane changes. Lane detection is performed using edge detection and Hough lines and is robust against poor image quality through super-resolution. Line filtering and clustering ensure reliable detection even in complex road layouts.

TASKS.1: Lane detection using edge detection and Hough lines
TASKS.2: Line filtering and clustering for reliable lane recognition
TASKS.3: Integration of super-resolution with lane detection
TASKS.4: Lane change detection based on vehicle positions

3.DESCRIPTION: Task Assigner is a web-based application for managing personal and team tasks. It supports personal task tracking and team management, including task assignment, role-based access control, and persistent storage in a MySQL database. The responsive frontend with Tailwind CSS provides an intuitive interface for switching between modes, teams, and task overview.

4.DESCRIPTION: An intelligent, video-based traffic monitoring system for estimating traffic flow and congestion levels on highways under varying lighting conditions. The system automatically adapts to different camera scenes and traffic patterns without requiring manual calibration, while relying on lightweight computer vision techniques suitable for resource-constrained environments.

TASKS.1: Traffic density estimation using background subtraction and contour analysis
TASKS.2: Automatic day and night scene classification based on illumination characteristics
TASKS.3: Unsupervised scene adaptation using Gaussian Mixture Models (GMMs)
TASKS.4: Learning road-specific traffic baselines for relative congestion estimation
